root_cause: Pass 2 of _assign_units_to_objectives prices OC with a 0/1 need ledger: OC past an objective's need is worth zero (the objective is 'already taken'), and any capture of an objective that still needs OC is worth its full candidate score, even when this unit's OC alone cannot meet the need and no other unit is coming. In all three findings the unit's top-scored candidate was the contested centre (17.5 / 21.8 / 43.9) but the ledger marked it covered by one other 9-OC guard, so the unit was redirected to its next objective that still needed OC: a flip of an 11-OC side objective with 9 OC ('needs 3 more OC after this unit', f1 3 turns, f2 2 turns) or a reinforcement still short of the enemy's 17 OC (f3, 'needs 1 more'). Nobody else was assigned there, so that capture controls nothing (control needs MORE OC than the enemy): its real marginal value under the same ledger is zero too, yet it beat the top-up purely because the ledger zeroed only the top-up. The 'moving toward charge target' text is a symptom (T7-23 charge-intent blending of the move), not the cause. Guardrails differ: g2/g5 pick their top-scored candidate with no redirect; g1 is a support-pass assignment; g3 is an attack; g4 (round 1) was redirected to a short flip of the centre but its top (obj_nml_1) is 3 turns away.
fix_summary: FIX_ATTACK_MOVE (default 1.0, gated by get_param; 0 = base code path exactly). In pass 2, remember each unit's best candidate skipped because the ledger said its objective was covered. Before applying a move/advance capture, if (a) the unit leaves the objective short (remaining need - unit OC > 0), (b) unassigned units that can reach that objective no later bring less OC than the gap, (c) the unit's covered best candidate scored higher, is a move/advance trip, its objective has enemy pressure (enemy OC in range or projected next move), and it is reached within max(2, the short capture's turns) moves, then both options have zero marginal value under the ledger and the candidate scores decide: the unit is assigned to top up the covered contested objective instead (apply_capture_assignment on that candidate; oc_consumed 0, need unchanged). Narrated reason + coordination note, and a [ATTACK_MOVE] log line. No change to the chase gate / charge-intent blending (compatible with the round-4 waaagh_advance_charge patch).

fires: Replays with the fix (1 seed each, horizon 1, both players): f1 1, f2 1, f3 2, f4 1, guardrails g1-g5 0. Fired decisions: f1 Guard A obj_nml_2 -> obj_center (17.5 vs 12.8); f2 Guard B obj_nml_1 -> obj_center (21.8 vs 14.5); f3 Guard C obj_nml_2 -> obj_center (43.9 vs 38.5) and later Guard B obj_nml_2 -> obj_center (46.2 vs 33.4); f4 Prosecutors obj_center (short by 2) -> obj_nml_1 (30.8 vs 28.5). Bench (mirror_custodes_2000_postdeploy, 1 pair, seed 93101): 0 [ATTACK_MOVE] lines in both games (M1 and M2, seed 93101; both games ended identically, margin -53 p2-p1, 681 actions, i.e. the fix never changed a decision there). The trigger (a unit's best objective marked covered AND its redirect left short with no help) did not occur in this seed; it occurred in all 4 finding replays (Custodes mirror / Custodes vs SW positions from rounds 2-3).
risks: (1) Concentration: units that used to fan out to side objectives now stack on the contested centre; secondaries that pay for presence across the table (Engage on All Fronts, Centre Ground's opposite, no-man's-land spread) may score less over 5 rounds - the round-2 FAR_TRIP/OVERCOMMIT lesson. The short capture's own secondary terms are still in its score, so it only loses when the top-up scores higher, but full-game effect is unmeasured. (2) The help check counts every unassigned unit with a candidate on the objective in time, even if it is later sent elsewhere - so the fix is conservative (fires less), not more. (3) A short capture that the NEXT turn's plan would have completed (round 1, multi-turn convergence) can be dropped; the 2-move reach limit kept the round-1 guardrail g4 unchanged, but other round-1 positions are untested. (4) The top-up only needs some enemy pressure (enemy OC in range or projected); against a much larger enemy force at the centre the top-up can still be a lost fight (RI-RACE prices that only for held_threatened). (5) Interaction with LONE-FLIP/REINFORCE-INSURANCE: tested with them on (V10 defaults); FIX_OVERCOMMIT path (off) untouched; KEEPER_RELEASE off.
